scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:all

scripts.lint:biome: biome ci app components lib worker build db tests scripts vite.config.ts next.config.ts drizzle.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs postcss.config.mjs commitlint.config.mjs stryker.config.mjs package.json biome.json knip.json tsconfig.json wrangler.local.jsonc
